{{Top|leg}}
The '''Royal Octans''' were among the ruling families of the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] before [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. The Octans gained their wealth as [[Pirate/Legends|space pirates]] by the use of [[Lost Stars of Nallastia|three power gems]] that disrupted [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic defense shields]], allowing them to overtake targeted ships and seize their property.<ref name="SWA:HTSR">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>

The [[Margrave Octan]] of [[Nallastia]] was a descendant of the Octans.<ref name="SWA:HTSR" />
